title: texts
description: Complete classical & world literature — search + cite exact passages, facing sources, 50+ languages.
summary: Complete classical & world literature — search + cite exact passages, facing sources, 50+ languages.
offersHint: Complete classical & world literature — search + cite exact passages, facing sources, 50+ languages. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://hermitsh.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_authors
toolsPreview.description: List author corpora available through Hermitsh Texts.

toolsPreview.name: list_works
toolsPreview.description: List works by author, category, or title/summary query.

toolsPreview.name: search_corpus
toolsPreview.description: Search passages across one author or the whole Hermitsh corpus and return source-linked results. Each result carries a url — include it as a link when quoting the passage.

toolsPreview.name: get_work
toolsPreview.description: Get metadata and opening passages for a specific work.

toolsPreview.name: get_passage
toolsPreview.description: Get an exact passage by author, work ID, and section ID. Include the returned url as a link when using the passage.

toolsPreview.name: cite_passage
toolsPreview.description: Format a Hermitsh work or passage citation in common citation styles.

toolsPreview.name: get_parallel_passage
toolsPreview.description: Get aligned source-language text and English translation for a passage when sidecar data is available.

toolsPreview.name: get_work_context
toolsPreview.description: Get richer work metadata: headnote, date context, source provenance, translation status, and edition links.

toolsPreview.name: search_parallel
toolsPreview.description: Search aligned source-language and English translation sidecars across the corpus.

toolsPreview.name: search_entities
toolsPreview.description: Search people, places, events, institutions, works, and concepts extracted from an author corpus.

toolsPreview.name: get_entity
toolsPreview.description: Get a named entity and a sample of source-linked mentions.

toolsPreview.name: find_mentions
toolsPreview.description: Return source-linked places where a person, place, event, work, institution, or concept is mentioned.

toolsPreview.name: search_letters
toolsPreview.description: Search correspondence metadata by correspondent, place, topic, mood, date range, or Greek usage where available.

toolsPreview.name: search_greek_phrases
toolsPreview.description: Search catalogued Greek phrases, glosses, suspected sources, register, and source-certainty metadata.

toolsPreview.name: get_crossrefs
toolsPreview.description: Get intra-corpus references and self-references for a work or section where available.

toolsPreview.name: get_allusions
toolsPreview.description: Get detected allusions, echoes, quotations, suspected sources, and translator notes for a work or section where available.

toolsPreview.name: get_language_availability
toolsPreview.description: Show source, active, deferred, and live edition status for one author or the whole Hermitsh library.

toolsPreview.name: build_source_pack
toolsPreview.description: Build an evidence pack for an AI answer: source-linked passages, related entities, and citation instructions.

toolsPreview.name: get_author_persona
toolsPreview.description: Get setup instructions for an AI assistant to answer as, about, or from the corpus of an author while using source-linked evidence.
